data.name: QprSigningText1
data.value: After 10 years of trusted collaboration with QPR Software, by the blessings of Allah Almighty, Leaders Solutions ( LS) acquired the territorial intellectual property rights in the Middle East & Africa for QPR Metrics— the strategy & performance management automation product. Also, LS became the exclusive partner in the Middle & Africa for QPR Process Mining product.

data.name: QprSigningText2
data.value: The two agreements were signed by His Excellency Sheikh Badr bin Majed Aldoweesh, the Founder and CEO of Leaders Solutions for Information Technology, and Mr. Heikki Veijola, the CEO of QPR Software.

data.name: QprSigningText3
data.value: This move reflects more than business growth years of shared success, mutual confidence, and a regional vision. It brings QPR’s global expertise closer to our clients through local presence and market understanding, and supports Saudi Vision 2030 by localizing technology and content, enabling technology transfer, skills development, and job creation.

data.name: QprSigningText4
data.value: This means faster, locally supported deployments of process‑intelligence and performance‑management solutions, deeper regional expertise, and end‑to‑end support for measurable operational improvements.

data.name: QprSigningText5
data.value: It’s worth mentioning, QPR is a Finnish company that was established in 1991 and is a pioneer and market leader in strategy & performance management automation. It has more than two thousand clients in more than 50 countries around the world.
